correctness.rationale: Derived the actual core update from n neighbors: for n=2m the next core is 0, old leaf vector, or 1 according as core weight is <m, =m, or >m; for n=2m+1 the two intermediate cases are complement(c)∩leaf and complement(c)∪(c∩leaf). Swapping core and leaf on the weight-m layer gives B=binom(n,m) even fixed-points B+2 and two-cycles B(B-1)/2; odd support-disjoint/covering cases give exactly B(m+2) two-cycle orbits, each basin 2^(m+1). Other states reach a homogeneous fixed point by <=3 updates; n=2,3 by <=2. Thus F^5=F^3 and exact entry-time formulas and Stirling asymptotics follow. Independent from-scratch adjacency-list majority transition enumerator n=2..6 checked every labelled initial state (sum 4^n=5456), orbit counts, all four depth bins, maximal entrance time and F^5=F^3. Source C++ and compressed Python verifiers were inspected, not treated as infinite proofs.
